term: every actual existent is through something
definition: For every x existing at w, some y satisfies through w x y. y may equal x. This is the typed open version of the through-something demand; unlike the existing existence-PSR, it requires a bearer-valued through relation rather than an arbitrary reason token.
note: Typed analyst reduction of the primary Tapp reconstruction (§6,89–91), informed by the independently materialized Latin Monologion III. Not a defense of premise truth or a new identity of through with efficient cause.
